hero.title: Engineer agentic AI systems by building them.
hero.summary: Study the concepts, check your understanding and write code that is evaluated automatically against tests. Your progress reflects the competencies you demonstrate, not the content you read.

study.title: Study
study.body: Work through vendor-neutral foundations. Vendor-specific notes are identified as such.

check.title: Check your understanding
check.body: Each module includes a knowledge check on what it teaches.

build.title: Build code
build.body: Each module includes at least one code challenge. Your code runs isolated, without network, and is evaluated automatically against tests, with feedback per criterion.

inspect.title: Inspect executions
inspect.body: Replay curated recordings of agent executions, step by step: tools, patterns, failures and human approval. No language model is called.

curriculum.title: Curriculum and paths
curriculum.intro: Every path in the published curriculum, in the recommended order.

challenges.title: Code challenges
challenges.intro: Each module includes at least one code challenge. Your code runs isolated, without network, and is evaluated automatically against tests, with feedback per criterion.
challenges.caption: Excerpt from a published challenge: its title, evaluation criteria and part of its starter code.

lab.title: Laboratories
lab.intro: Follow how an agent uses tools, follows a pattern, fails and waits for human approval, step by step.
lab.disclosure: The laboratory replays curated recordings. No language model is called.
lab.practice: Laboratories are practice: they do not count as evidence of a competency.
lab.caption: Excerpt from a published recording: the task, one tool call with its permission, an authored explanation and the approval step.

competencies.title: Skills and competencies
competencies.intro: What the paths available today develop. Your progress follows the competencies you demonstrate.

prerequisites.title: What you need to know already
prerequisites.intro: What the first available path expects from you before you start.

closing.title: Start building
closing.body: Modules, knowledge checks and code challenges are available with an account, and your progress follows the competencies you demonstrate.
